title: COMPliance With Avonex® PS in Patients With Relapsing-Remitting MS
brief_summary: A phase IV, observational, survey-based study to measure compliance with Avonex® PS therapy in patients with Relapsing-Remitting Multiple Sclerosis, and to compare persistence on therapy 22 months after initial prescription of AVONEX® PS between patients enrolled in the current MS AllianceTM program versus patients enrolled in this program prior to October 2007.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with Relapsing Remitting Multiple Sclerosis (RRMS)
* Prescription of AVONEX® PS (prefilled syringes)
* Enrolment in the MS AllianceTM program
study_population: Patients enrolled in the MS AllianceTM program
